finding: The previously planned production materialization via fixed_flux_top_boundary_provider_t is not generally physics-equivalent to the legacy production HeadCalc route. Legacy HeadCalc calls boundtop_state_bridge(2) on every residual evaluation. The legacy boundtop calculation depends on current top-node head/conductivity, computes evaporation limitation, may switch between flux and prescribed-head surface regimes, and may activate ponding/runoff. Therefore current qtop is not a generally valid pre-resolved immutable forcing for the typed solve.

facts: vector_F() invokes boundtop_state_bridge(2) for each residual evaluation
when an explicit top provider is active, HeadCalc delegates top-boundary evaluation to that provider instead of legacy boundtop
the currently qualified fixed-flux provider simply returns requested%top_flux and cannot reproduce legacy dynamic regime switching

fixed_flux_provider.fact: evaluate() returns requested top_flux, surface_head=pressure_head_top and zero runoff; it has no legacy atmospheric-demand/ponding/runoff semantics.

facts: validate_legacy_request() requires FSI_TOP_MODE_EXPLICIT_FLUX and an associated top_boundary provider
F-SI28 therefore cannot currently use the internal legacy boundtop branch while remaining in its qualified explicit-provider route

boundtop_behavior: computes atmospheric-head conductivity and Darcy evaporation capacity from current h(1)
forms q1 from precipitation/irrigation/snow/runon/evaporation and prior ponding
switches to atmospheric prescribed-head when demand exceeds Emax
otherwise tests whether the flux condition implies surface head <= threshold
may switch to ponded prescribed-head/runoff state

architectural_consequence: Implementing KT15 with the fixed-flux provider would make numerical/transaction composition silently alter surface physics, violating physics-vs-policy separation and the requirement to maximally reuse SWAP physics. KT15 must not do this.

required_predecessor.scope: Qualify a production-bound explicit top-boundary provider that reproduces the admitted legacy B1.10 atmospheric/evaporation/ponding/runoff surface boundary semantics without depending on HeadCalc internals or persistent solver scratch.
must_preserve: legacy flux/head regime selection in qualified scope
no silent simplification to fixed qtop

kt15_rule_until_predecessor_qualified: Fail closed: do not modify SoilWater(2) production routing and do not claim solver-service production composition. The existing direct legacy HeadCalc path remains the sole production hydraulic authority.
